In detail

The dense working quarter inland of the centre, and the one rione that has genuinely changed character in recent years. It is on the Polizia Locale's #RioniSicuri list, and February 2026 anti-degrado operations named Campo San Giacomo specifically. What residents report there, per Il Piccolo's account of the programme, is quality-of-life rather than violence: loitering, noise, abandoned vehicles and small-scale dealing. Ordinary and lively by day.
